div.head: Northu 56
div.ab: Se þe ænige þissa do, gilde wite: friman XII ór, ðeowan ða hyde;—buton wegferende, þa moton for neode meteneade ferian; 7 for unfriðe man mot freolsæfenan nide fulfaran betweonan Eferwic 7 six mila gemete.

He who does any of these things is to pay the penalty: a freemen 12 ores, a slave with a flogging; except for travellers, who are permitted to carry sustenance for their needs; and in case of hostility one may travel because of necessity between York and a distance of six miles on the eve of festivals.

One who does any of these things is to pay a penalty: a freeman twelve ores, a slave with a beating; except for travellers, who may carry food out of necessity; and in times of conflict one may, out of necessity, joiurney a distance of up to six miles from York on the eve of a holy day.
